name: Mo's Cozy Cabana
description:
The Cozy Cabana is a funky & cozy studio located in a quiet neighborhood and only minutes walking distance to the hustle and bustle of the village and the famous Split. The interior is rustic, though comfortable. If you want a touch of the real Belizean lifestyle, this is the place to be.

neighborhood_overview: The cabana is just a moments walk to 'The Split', where the island is split in two and which is the most popular spot for swimming, snorkeling or to have a drink at the famous bar 'the Lazy Lizard'. The main street -Front Street- is right around the corner. Here you'll find several restaurants, supermarkets, souvenir shops and food- and fruit stands. The many local people you meet are always in for a chat. The part of the island where the cabana is located is only 100 yards wide so the sea & beach are always nearby.

name: Stay on a Maya Site, 100 Acres Jungle, by ATM Cave
description:
Lower Dover is a beautiful jungle lodge with 100 acres of protected jungle, wildlife and a Maya site in our backyard. Hiking trails on our property, two creeks and the Belize River to swim in, jungle & farm animals. Closest hostel to the ATM Cave. Central in the Cayo area, near bus stop. MC/Visa OK
* ATM Cave & Tikal tours arranged for you
Private cabana (1 double bed), rainwater shower. Screens, ceiling & floor fans, private veranda. Unlimited filtered drinking water included.
neighborhood_overview: Our village is small (pop. 1000) but lively (6 bars & 6 churches).  But Lower Dover is on the fringe of town & secluded & quiet.   The neighbors you'll see will all be wild animals & birds since we are surrounded by jungle and waterways.
host_about: NEAR... YET TOTALLY FAR OUT! Ranked #1 Specialty lodge in western Belize by TripAdvisor!  Lower Dover is close to the famous ATM Cave & a 15 min walk from a busy public bus stop in Unitedville yet you'll feel like you are on a secluded jungle isle surrounded by rivers.  You'll be sleeping atop Maya ceremonial grounds & surrounded by 100 acres of Maya ruins, exotic wildlife, nesting toucans, deep jungle & huge trees. Come explore nature trails, swim in fresh water streams, see nesting Toucans & learn about medicinal plants & Maya/British/Mennonites history.  Awake to sounds of the rainforest & an organic farm. There are clean, safe accommodations for every budget plus adventure tours, local food, warm hospitality & big on-site Maya ruins (est. population 10,000 in 900 A.D) hidden in the jungle just outside your cabana door. Centrally located in Cayo District location (between Belmopan & San Ignacio or a 2 hour ride from Hopkins) Lower Dover is a base camp for those traveling from the BZE international airport, the coast, cayes, or Tikal. If you are from Wisconsin, get your photo taken with Bucky Badger!  blog:  LDFieldJournal.wordpress.

name: Howler House: A romantic riverside treehouse
description: Howler Jungle house and cabana  as its knows as now offers 3 extra cabins. The original tree house  sits high in the jungle canopy over the river 20 mins from the airport. Or, I can assist with a rental.
neighborhood_overview: Burrell Boom is a lovely little rural village along the banks of the Old Belize river. The people here are extremely friendly. If you walk up to the village and stop for some food at Miss Carol's, a cold beer at Yellow Man's pub - right next door, you will be enchanted by this little village. If you want to do some Reggie dancing, head down to Henderson's Bank on Friday or Saturday night, just follow the music -- you can walk, but bring the flashlight! Everyone will welcome you. This is a small friendly village and I hope you will have the opportunity to meet and enjoy the company and food of the local people - they are wonderful. The Black Orchid is a 15 minute walk down a lovely rural road. Or, a ten minute bike ride - the house has two bikes, And, once you arrive, you can have a cool drink and slip into the pool: ahhhhhh. They will treat you like gold, slowly.
host_about: I am people person that enjoy meeting new people. A lot of the expats work with the many embassies and consulates, and have an active community and social life in Belmopan. I also like to have a fixed base and make day trips...something that is quite possible living in Belmopan, as it is in the center of the small but beautiful country of Belize.

description:
Breakfast for 3 persons included in rate.

In the northern district of Orange Walk, we are midway between Belize City and the border city of Chetumal, Mexico to the north (one hour drive in either direction). Our property is Gold Standard Approved for your health and safety.

Open walls & semi private bedrooms; an 8 minute drive from Orange Walk Town. Cabin #11 is part of a 2 story duplex. Kitchen, breakfast bar, living room, loft, large porch. 1 queen bed, 1 double bed, 1 futon
neighborhood_overview:
Orange Walk is a true feel of small town Northern Belize. If you're coming in from Belize City, look out for the sugar factory at the entrance of the town (you'll see two smoke stacks on your right hand side). Acres and acres of cane fields line the highways and villages surrounding Orange Walk. We are also home to 2 of the 3 rum distilleries in Belize. An 8-minute drive will take you to the center of town. The street leading to the market is blocked off for pedestrians on Saturday mornings. Take a stroll and buy some fresh fruit.

Orange Walk is not one of the traditional tourist destinations in Belize. Come here for Mayan Temples, culture, Mestizo cuisine, rum, and friendly people.

If you like adventure, we offer tour of Lamanai Archaeological Site that depart from the riverside deck on the property. More info about this in the "other things to note" section.

....Or you can relax and do nothing. If you don't want to leave the property, Marac
host_about:

― Rumi

host_about:
Gold Standard Certified Property Owner, all units are certified and available for guests. 

I'm Lisa, I first visited Belize in 2016 and fell in love with the feel of the country of Belize. Every region has it's own magic, but I found mine on Ambergris Caye in San Pedro. The people are the friendliest that you will find anywhere and will make you feel welcome! 

I am not just an Abnb host that has an extra bedroom or unit to rent out and want to make a few extra bucks.  Belize Tropical Dream Villas is a unique property with an invested and hospitality trained owner. This property and the guests that stay with me are the heart of my business!  

My life dreams and goals have included being near the ocean for years now and I have the heart for hospitality.  After getting dual degrees in Hospitality Management and Culinary Arts, I began looking for a place to make my dream a reality!  

Belize met my 5 criteria: 
1. Close to the ocean  
2. English speaking  
3. Easy currency conversion
4. Affordable and fairly quick for our guests to get to 
5. Affordable to purchase inside our means

When the opportunity was presented to be able to purchase an apartment building in my favorite city - I decided to make a leap of faith and catch my dream! 

I am excited to share the island with you, help you feel comfortable and at home here, and most important - ensure that you have a most memorable vacation filled with experiences unique to the beautiful country of Belize!  

- Your Host, Lisa

host_about:
Hi, I like to work hard and play hard.  I multi-task and am engaged in many productive endeavors at any one time, but I also love to party and meet friends.  I enjoy reading for pleasure...not too serious material, and learning new languages.  I love to have intellectual discussion and debate...and I like swimming.

As your host, I will basically leave you your space, but am easily reachable for any questions or assistance you may need.  I like to provide an initial introduction to places, activities, and people in the immediate environment, so that you feel comfortable of your surroundings as soon as possible.  Because I work full time I am honest about the time when I can be available on any given day.

When I myself travel, I love to do so by road whenever possible and by staying at more basic accommodations, because I think that's when you best get to KNOW the people and place you visit.  I also like to have a fixed base and make day trips...something that is quite possible living in Belmopan, as it is in the center of the small but beautiful country of Belize.

It would be great if you choose to visit Belmopan, Belize, as the people and the country are multi-cultural, interesting, friendly and helpful.  I wish that someday you decide to grace us with a visit.

name: Oceanfront, five private porches, panoramic views!
description: This two-level ocean front penthouse has five private balconies with panoramic views of the gorgeous blue ocean, the exotic jungle, and the peaceful resort.  Our tropical island rental overlooks a white-sand beach, and the second largest barrier reef in the world.  A PADI-certified dive shop picks you up at our dock. This three-bedroom island rental is in a friendly village-style resort with a tropical vibe. It's located 10 miles north of San Pedro on Ambergris Caye in Belize. The second largest barrier reef in the world is right outside our door. Belize is known for world-class diving and snorkeling, as well as fly fishing and deep sea fishing.

This is not a big loud party resort, this is a laid-back, tranquil and peaceful resort for nature-appreciating, adventurous types who want to wind down and leave the fast pace of San Pedro town behind.

This rental is remote and secluded. Be ready for adventure!
host_about: I've always loved to travel, but I found my home in Belize.  I step off the plane in Belize City, and my outlook changes.  At home, I'm busy, hard-working, and driven.  In Belize, I'm just relaxed and happy.  I can't wait until Relaxed and Happy becomes my full-time thing.  In a few years I'll retire and live in my condo full-time, but until then, you're all welcome to enjoy it.

name: San Ignacio, Belize, The Garden House
description:
The Garden House is a 5 minute DRIVE from the beautiful town of San Ignacio, in the Cayo District. The Cayo District is where most adventures take place. Some of the many activities that you can do consist of cave-tubing, zip-lining, climbing archaeological sites, canoeing, and exploring waterfalls.

description: Our little Casita is a short 5 min drive from the heart of San Ignacio and nestled umungst the native land scape of the rainforest. neighborhood_overview: Our neighborhood is small, we live at the top of the hill and have three neighbors that are local. Very private, very safe and we love it. If your staying July, Aug, Sep, enjoy two very high producing Avocado trees. Jun, July, and Aug, enjoy native fruit of our mango trees. We also have a Bread fruit tree, Feb,March, April, and May. They are used like potatoes, boil, bake or fry!!! Two huge almond trees that produce all year long. A tamarin fruit tree, Nov, Dec, and Jan. They are pod looking, eat, or make fresh Tamarin juice. host_about:
Hello, We are Rose and Nancy Vella, we are natives to Sonoma County California. We have known each other since 1977, and got legally married January 18, 2015 at our beautiful Bodega Head, with our 4 closest friends. We had our big wedding 5/15/15 for our family and friends. Rose bought our Belize home in 2011, as an investment and a retirement get away. We are both lovers of travel, traveling in our trailer, camping, going to SF Giants games, going to concerts, and old cars. Rose has been to Europe twice to spend time with her family in Malta. She has also traveled around Italy, Greece, Canada, England, Hawaii, Mexico,Belize, Costa Rica, and the caribbean.
Not to mention various places with in the US.  I'v been to Mexico, Hawaii and Belize. We own two 55 Chevy's and are avid car show participants. Rose drove me to school my sophomore year everyday in that car and we of course had some of or favorite wedding photos taken in our yellow and white 55. 
We take care of my 83 year old dad, nicknamed DADDY-O. So when we need some much needed time away, well you know where we head...... Thats right 
our lovey little casita in San Ignacio Belize. 
Roses motto is " Do It Once, Do It Right" 
So that's how she lives her life!
As for me..... Well my motto is " Everyday Is A Good Day, Some Are Just Better Than Others"

description: This Secluded Guest House is located on 5 acres in the village of Bullet Tree. The property is "Off Grid", eco-friendly. Tastefully decorated with one king size bed, stacked full and twin bunk beds, LR, Dining area and Kitchen.  Quiet and secluded with the sounds of Nature breaking the silence. . host_about: I am a 12 year expat to Belize. I moved here to slow down my life, and live longer. I enjoy the .  of life and the visible love of the Belizeans as well as the other expats here.  You quickly learn patience here in Belize. It is a nice change.  Living here has also given me the opportunity to travel more. I have visited most of the countries in the Caribbean as well as Cuba since being here. I traveled extensively before moving here, but the close proximity makes it so much easier.  I have traveled also to Spain, China, Britain, Africa, Mexico, Canada and Cuba, so it gives me some insight as to what people look for while being away from home. It is my goal to make our home your home while you are here.  I will give you space, but will be here for whatever your needs are.  I love being a host. I love meeting people. I love seeing people enjoy what our little paradise has to offer.

neighborhood_overview:
This is a very vibrant community, with long-time Belizeans and Central American Belizeans living in the area. Within a couple blocks you have bakery, local eateries, supermarket, laundromat, vegetable market, etc.

You can have live comfortably and interestingly in Belmopan. This area has a multi-ethnic population, comprised of the Creole, Garifuna, Maya, Central American Mestizo, Chinese, Taiwanese, Indian, North-Americans, and many Europeans. A lot of the expats work with the many embassies and consulates, and have an active community and social life in Belmopan. As home to the University of Belize, seat of government and location of several embassies and consulates, Belmopan also receives a lot of commuting workers on a daily basis.
host_about:
Hi, I like to work hard and play hard.  I multi-task and am engaged in many productive endeavors at any one time, but I also love to party and meet friends.  I enjoy reading for pleasure...not too serious material, and learning new languages.  I love to have intellectual discussion and debate...and I like swimming.

I  am easily reachable for any questions or assistance you may need.  I like to provide an initial introduction to places, activities, and people in the immediate environment, so that you feel comfortable of your surroundings as soon as possible.  Because I work full time I am honest about the time when I can be available on any given day.

When I myself travel, I love to do so by road whenever possible and by staying at more basic accommodations, because I think that's when you best get to KNOW the people and place you visit. neighborhood_overview:
AJ Palms is in the village of Hopkins, which is part of the charm I think, but I also know that it is not what everybody is looking for.
Hopkins is still very much a village community in a developing country. We are a village, not a resort tourist destination.
Hopkins is a wonderful community with a unique Garifuna culture, come to Hopkins with that in mind, embrace a different land and culture, and you will love it.
If you are looking for an isolated, or resort experience for your vacation, then we may not be the right place for you.
Being in the village can sometimes mean you will hear children, dogs, radios, chicken and roosters, and we do have a restaurant next door that sometimes plays loud music, but mostly you will hear the breeze through the palm trees and the sound of the waves.

I'm enjoying my life on the beach.

I'm enjoying my life on the beach.

neighborhood_overview:
It’s true: parts of Belize are getting touristy. But San Ignacio remains rustic, making it a great base for budget-friendly tropical adventure travel, as well as a great base for a day trip to Tikal in neighboring Guatemala

The rainy season is between June and August and is the most beautiful time of year, where the rainforests truly come to life and where the short burst of mid-afternoon rain serves to cool. The dry season is from February through May.
Average annual rainfall in most parts of Belize is about 50 inches, but the Cayo District receives significantly less—fewer than 15 inches per year.

San Ignacio is at the heart of the Cayo district of Belize. It’s a great jumping-off point for exploring Belizean nature, culture, and history.

My life dreams and goals have included being near the ocean for years now and I have the heart for hospitality.  After getting dual degrees in Hospitality Management and Culinary Arts, I began looking for a place to make my dream a reality!  

Belize met my 5 criteria: 
1. Close to the ocean  
2. English speaking  
3. Easy currency conversion
4. Affordable and fairly quick for our guests to get to 
5. Affordable to purchase inside our means

When the opportunity was presented to be able to purchase an apartment building in my favorite city - I decided to make a leap of faith and catch my dream! 

I am excited to share the island with you, help you feel comfortable and at home here, and most important - ensure that you have a most memorable vacation filled with experiences unique to the beautiful country of Belize!  

- Your Host, Lisa

host_about:
We’re Brian and Brenda Montgomery – Manatee Villa is our dream home and we’re delighted to be able to share it with you.

The story of our Villa has been a long time in the making. In fact, it goes all the way back to 2003, when Brian received a life-changing diagnosis. 
 
When you learn you have Stage 4 cancer and are given just six months to live, you begin to reflect on the things that are important to you.

For us it was family and loved ones first and foremost – and the wonderful experiences we could share together.

It was during that trying time when the idea of a beachside retreat came to us. But our dream seemed just that – a dream.

Brian was undergoing treatment, and we were fighting with all that we had to hold on to him.

One evening, with the lyrics of the Beach Boys’ Kokomo washing over us, we made a bold decision. We’d fight through this, and when Brian was well enough, we’d begin exploring the beauty of the Caribbean.

That day finally came, and we were off to Jamaica and then Aruba shortly thereafter.

Years passed, and life intervened, but that dream was always in front of us.

Then one year our travels took us to the stunning beaches of Placencia, Belize.

With its perfect weather, gorgeous setting and wonderful people, Placencia captured our hearts like nowhere else. We knew we’d found the setting for our Villa.

Every piece of Manatee Villa has been crafted for spending time with loved ones – for relaxing, connecting and making memories together.

It’s luxurious, private and a true home away from home in one of the most relaxing settings in the world.

And we’re delighted to have you join our family and become a part of our story.

Because our Villa is your villa. And we can’t wait for you to arrive!

- Brian and Brenda

The area does not have a touristy vibe and especially during rainy weather, the streets can be bad. Beware that Belize is a developing country and minimum wage is low. This means that few people can afford a house of their own and often more than 1 family live on a property under sometimes poor conditions.

Caye Caulker is a small island and the main restaurants, shops, supermarkets, dive-/snorkel tour operators are about a 20-30 minute walk or a 15-20 minute bike ride away. In the area close to the house are a few small food stalls and the nearest grocery store is a few minutes by bike. Three purpose built guest rooms downstairs from my home. They share a veranda with two hammocks for each room. Seafish is the middle room. We are located on a lovely beach with shady palms - in the Garifuna fishing village of Hopkins.
Hopkins is a village that gives you access to kayaking, snorkeling, diving the barrier reef, jungle treks, and Mayan ruins.

Come to Hopkins with that in mind, embrace a different land and culture, and you will love it. If you are looking for a resort style vacation, then we may not be the right place for you. Being in the village can sometimes mean you will hear children, dogs, radios, chicken and roosters, but mostly you will hear the breeze through the palm trees and the sound of the waves.
host_about:

I'm British by birth, and naturalized Belizean by choice. 

I lived in Germany, off and on, for 10 years before moving to Belize. I am fairly good at speaking German, not all that great at writing it - but I am willing to try. 

I've always felt renting out my rooms and apartments is like renting out a part of my home, hopefully my guests get to feel the same way when they I host them.

I'm enjoying my life on the beach.

Hopkins is a beach village that gives you access to kayaking, snorkeling, diving the barrier reef, jungle treks, and Mayan ruins. Open your room door. Step right out onto the beach. Step into the Caribbean sea.
neighborhood_overview: We are right on the beach! We are in the village of Hopkins, which is part of the charm I think, but I also know that it is not what everybody is looking for. Hopkins is still very much a village community, not a resort tourist destination, but it is a wonderful community with a unique Garifuna culture. Come to Hopkins with that in mind, embrace a different land and culture, and you will love it. If you are looking for a resort style vacation, then we may not be the right place for you. Being in the village can sometimes mean you will hear children, dogs, radios, chicken and roosters, but mostly you will hear the breeze through the palm trees and the sound of the waves.
host_about:
I am the owner and manager of a guesthouse in Hopkins since 1998 and I've managed AJ Palms Apartments since 2014. 
I'm British by birth, and naturalized Belizean by choice. 

I lived in Germany, off and on, for 10 years before moving to Belize. I am fairly good at speaking German, not all that great at writing it - but I am willing to try. 

I've always felt renting out my rooms and apartments is like renting out a part of my home, hopefully my guests get to feel the same way when they I host them.

I'm enjoying my life on the beach.

description: The Coconut House is a beautifully renovated property with ocean views, just steps from the Caribbean Sea. Once a sleepy fishing village, Placencia has emerged as a “must go to destination” to enjoy outdoor adventures, beachfront bars, a variety of restaurants, and spacious beaches. Carolyn

I am not just an Abnb host that has an extra bedroom or unit to rent out and want to make a few extra bucks.  Belize Tropical Dream Villas is a unique property with an invested and hospitality trained owner. This property and the guests that stay with me are the heart of my business!

2. English speaking  
3. Easy currency conversion
4. Affordable and fairly quick for our guests to get to 
5. Affordable to purchase inside our means

When the opportunity was presented to be able to purchase an apartment building in my favorite city - I decided to make a leap of faith and catch my dream! 

I am excited to share the island with you, help you feel comfortable and at home here, and most important - ensure that you have a most memorable vacation filled with experiences unique to the beautiful country of Belize!  

- Your Host, Lisa

Belize has a lot to offer to travelers, and the Cayo District in Western Belize is ground zero if you want to make the most of your time here. Guatemala is just a stone’s throw away, but you could stay for months without having to cross over the border to find new things to do.

Cayo used to be the beating heart of the Maya civilization in Belize, and that means that there are still plenty of well-preserved ruins to explore. The same qualities that made Cayo such fertile territory for the Mayas also makes it an ideal location to live, work, and play.

host_about:
I am Virginia Krohn and I am not only the owner of Villa Cayo but I designed, drew the plans for and built the villas.  I am also a real estate broker and the owner of Belize Live-Retire-Invest  which is myself and a group of expats dedicated to helping other people relocate to Belize. 


Originally from Texas I am a sculptor, painter and a custom home builder who knows how to pay attention to detail. Living on the beach for almost 20 years just 60' from that beautiful teal water was magical.  As the island changed the magic did disappear and the new dream became building a luxury Eco-resort in the jungle.

 

One of the best things I like about Belize is that I can afford to have someone help run our business,  have a housekeeper and a gardener which allows me the time to do the creative things I want to do while providing jobs for talented Belizeans.  Belize is not for everyone and it is only what you make of it.

name: Beachfront guest suite w/ private bath. "Seashell"
description:
Three purpose built guest rooms downstairs from my home. They share a veranda with two hammocks for each room. Seashell is an end room. We are located on a lovely beach with shady palms - in the Garifuna fishing village of Hopkins.
Hopkins is a village that gives you access to kayaking, snorkeling, diving the barrier reef, jungle treks, and Mayan ruins.
Open your room door. Step right out onto the beach. Step into the Caribbean sea.
neighborhood_overview: We are right on the beach! We are in the village of Hopkins, which is part of the charm I think, but I also know that it is not what everybody is looking for. Hopkins is still very much a village community, not a resort tourist destination, but it is a wonderful community with a unique Garifuna culture. Come to Hopkins with that in mind, embrace a different land and culture, and you will love it. If you are looking for a resort style vacation, then we may not be the right place for you. Being in the village can sometimes mean you will hear children, dogs, radios, chicken and roosters, but mostly you will hear the breeze through the palm trees and the sound of the waves.
host_about:
I am the owner and manager of a guesthouse in Hopkins since 1998 and I've managed AJ Palms Apartments since 2014. 
I'm British by birth, and naturalized Belizean by choice. 

I lived in Germany, off and on, for 10 years before moving to Belize. I am fairly good at speaking German, not all that great at writing it - but I am willing to try. 

I've always felt renting out my rooms and apartments is like renting out a part of my home, hopefully my guests get to feel the same way when they I host them.

I'm enjoying my life on the beach.

Gold Standard Certified Property Owner, all units are certified and available for guests. 

I'm Lisa, I first visited Belize in 2016 and fell in love with the feel of the country of Belize. Every region has it's own magic, but I found mine on Ambergris Caye in San Pedro. The people are the friendliest that you will find anywhere and will make you feel welcome! 

I am not just an Abnb host that has an extra bedroom or unit to rent out and want to make a few extra bucks.  Belize Tropical Dream Villas is a unique property with an invested and hospitality trained owner. This property and the guests that stay with me are the heart of my business!  

My life dreams and goals have included being near the ocean for years now and I have the heart for hospitality.  After getting dual degrees in Hospitality Management and Culinary Arts, I began looking for a place to make my dream a reality!  

Belize met my 5 criteria: 
1. Close to the ocean  
2. English speaking  
3. Easy currency conversion
4. Affordable and fairly quick for our guests to get to 
5. Affordable to purchase inside our means

When the opportunity was presented to be able to purchase an apartment building in my favorite city - I decided to make a leap of faith and catch my dream! 

I am excited to share the island with you, help you feel comfortable and at home here, and most important - ensure that you have a most memorable vacation filled with experiences unique to the beautiful country of Belize!  

- Your Host, Lisa

host_about:
Stephen Honeybill has been a gentleman of adventure and a world traveler his whole life.  His career as an award winning producer / director of television programs began at the BBC and subsequently PBS. His career allowed him to fulfill his passion to explore many of the world’s most interesting and beautiful countries.  In his personal travels, he sailed a 50 foot ketch 10,000 miles from Hong Kong to the Mediterranean, surviving an attack by pirates in the Indian Ocean.  Stephen was also the navigator of “Ten Romeo” a single engine Beach Bonanza from Albany, New York to the North Pole.  Later, on a trans-Atlantic flight, the crew set a world speed record for a flight from Washington D.C. to Moscow.
A trip in 2010 brought Stephen to Belize, where Queen Elizabeth graces the country’s bank notes and English is spoken.  In early 2011, he moved to Belize. After designing and overseeing the construction, The Crimson Orchid Inn opened in December of 2012.

neighborhood_overview:
Orange Walk is a true feel of small town Northern Belize. If you're coming in from Belize City, look out for the sugar factory at the entrance of the town (you'll see two smoke stacks on your right hand side). Acres and acres of cane fields line the highways and villages surrounding Orange Walk. We are also home to 2 of the 3 rum distilleries in Belize. An 8-minute drive will take you to the center of town. The street leading to the market is blocked off for pedestrians on Saturday mornings. Take a stroll and buy some fresh fruit.

Orange Walk is not one of the traditional tourist destinations in Belize. Come here for Mayan Temples, culture, Mestizo cuisine, rum, and friendly people.

description:

We have an abundance of many types of tropical fruit and flowering trees.

Near the Mayan village of San Antonio, it is one of the closest of rentable properties to the tourist attractions in the Mountain Pine Ridge.

Eden Farm's many tropical fruit trees include: Jamaica Lime, soursop, avocado, banana, orange, tamarind, breadfruit, cashew, coconut, starfruit, mango and grapefruit, among many.
Howler monkeys are sometimes heard just off the property.
The farm abuts Elijio Panti Medicinal Reserve, which can be accessed via San Antonio village, with a local guide.
San Antonio village is a close-knit, friendly Yucatec Mayan village, which is renowned for healers and artists. The late Elijio Panti is the most famous of healers in Belize, and used to reside and work in the village. He taught a number of healers in the area, and is immortalised in the book "Sastun: My Apprenticeship with a Maya Healer" by Rosita Arvigo, which is worth reading.
The village has 2 small stores, a bakery, several restaurants and takeaways, and 7 churches.
There is a Mayan site called Pacbitun, a short distance beyond the farm.

neighborhood_overview:
The Great House Inn is located in the historic Fort George Area: The Fort George area, a peninsula ringed by Marine Parade Boulevard and Fort Street, is one of the most pleasant in Belize City. Meander in the neighborhood and you’ll pass some impressive homes and buildings, including The Great House Inn now the only colonial guest house. The Baron Bliss Memorial and Fort George Lighthouse stand guard over it all. Towering over the coastline and facing the Belize Harbor, the Fort George Lighthouse was built as part of the memorial for Baron Bliss, Belize’s greatest benefactor. In fulfillment of his dying wish and financed with the generous proceeds he left the country, the tall structure was erected next to his tomb and memorial. While the public cannot enter the lighthouse, it remains an important, historic landmark in Belize City and is easy to spot while touring the Fort George area. The views from there also make for a nice photo op.

As the island changed the magic did disappear and the new dream became building a luxury Eco-resort in the jungle.

name: Palmento Grove Garifuna  Live-In Experience
description: Located on historic Kalipuna Island on the north end of Hopkins Village in southeastern Belize, Palmento Grove Garifuna Eco-Cultural & Healing Institute is a private island retreat designed to reflect the authenticity of a traditional Garifuna village. Owned and operated by local Garifuna people of Afro-Caribbean descent that embraces a history of always being free people, Palmento Grove is one of the best places to experience authentic Garifuna Culture in Belize.
neighborhood_overview: Palmento Grove Garifuna Eco-Cultural & Healing Institute is the only full service indigenous owned vacation service provider in Hopkins offering authentic Garifuna & Belizean Cultural Experiences.   We are please to share our culture with our guests while our business also serves to provide & fund Garifuna Cultural Preservation Projects to our Garifuna Community of Hopkins. We are located at the Freshwater Lagoon Estuary which is the most popular fishing spot in Hopkins.  Over Johnson Island was originally  the home of 3 Yugandan sisters from which Hopkins derived its Garifuna name Yugada.  In the early 1900s a British overseer succeeded in occupying the island. The island then became a hub for commercial activities such as agricultural farm management, timber extraction & cattle farming.   Over Johnson Island is known to have the oldest well that provided portable water in the Commerce Bight Area that has been there for over 70 years.  The island continues to be of great historic sign
host_about: Director of Palmento Grove Garifuna Eco-Cultural & Fishing Institute, Located on the north side of Hopkins Village in southeastern Belize, Palmento Grove Garifuna Eco-Cultural and Fishing Institute consists of both a private island retreat and an inland Tour & Travel Services Business designed to reflect the authenticity of a traditional Garifuna village. Owned and operated by local Garifuna people, an Afro-Caribbean culture indigenous to Belize, Palmento Grove is one of the best places to experience authentic local culture in Belize.For more than 10 years, Palmento Grove Garifuna Eco-Cultural and Fishing Institute has served as a sustainable tourism business and a cultural preservation center. Situated amongst beautiful mangrove bushes on the edge of Fresh Water Creek Lagoon where it meets the Caribbean Sea, Palmento Grove feels like a world away. Specializing in authentic Garifuna cuisine and cultural activities, the institute serves as an outstanding introduction to Garifuna history and culture. Guests of Palmento Grove can wander the footpaths on this isolated strip of island or head out with local fishermen to try your luck at catching some of the many abundant species of fish and seafood that thrive in the area. Spend your vacation in this recently renovated second floor beach front condo. Relax on your balcony and enjoy the breathtaking view of the beautiful Barrier reef. This condo comes with a fully equipped kitchen for all your vacation cooking needs.

Just to the north of our property (a 2 minute walk on the beach) is 303 Belize, an over the water bar and restaurant. They are open for lunch and dinner (every day of the week) and focus more on seafood. They have live music most evenings as well. Underneath 303 Belize, is Elite Adventures, a dive and snorkel shop.
Just south of our property is the Farmhouse Market and Cafe. They offer a wide selection of fresh coffees, juices/smoothies,

Tres Cocos Resort @ The Cloisters, is a charming family-run establishment where island living meets modern comfort. 
We have fond childhood memories on the property before its transformation into a vacation rental oasis. 
Each condo is individually owned and thoughtfully appointed, ensuring a unique and personalized experience for our guests. We invite you to experience the warmth of Belizean hospitality in every detail during your stay with us.

What is BAKKATOWN Belize?

This is where the local working people live.


- Guests can live “with the Locals”.
- Eating and shopping and socializing at local shops.
- Meeting people as they go about their days and evenings.

We provide economical accommodations for Travellers.

Travellers who want to spend their time and money on activities and experiences.

description: This is a quiet, discreet cabin set apart from the others to ensure full privacy.  You can enjoy spectacular sunsets relaxing in your large hammock. neighborhood_overview: Teakettle is a rural/farming village. just minutes away from the capital city. Those who are not farmers commute to Belmopan for work and other government business. Teakettle is known for the spectacular and well-preserved Maya cave system Actun Tunicil Maknal (ATM) which contains centuries-old skeletons, ceramics and other Maya objects. Other Maya archaeological sites like Cahal Pech and Xunantunich are less than an hour's drive.
host_about: I am a retired diplomat and former senior officer in the Government of Belize. I enjoy nature and the quiet serenity of the rainforest. I also love people, great music, great conversations and great movies. I have travelled all over the world in my capacity as Ambassador, and have met many interesting people with whom I still keep in contact. My wife, Bernadette, and I are very open-minded and treat our guests as friends and kin. Retirement from diplomacy meant a new direction, so we chose to build three cottages and open our private retreat to paying guests, which would keep us in contact with people from all over the world. We love it here. We are happy to have you join us in a welcoming, uncomplicated environment where warmth and friendship await you. The longer you stay, the happier we all are. We particularly like to host persons who are on short or long-term consultancies in the Belmopan area; newlyweds looking for a honeymoon getaway, couples with young families, or adventurous grown-ups who use our place as a base for forays into rock-climbing, zip-lining, cave-tubing, rainforest hiking or ancient Maya site explorations; also retired couples who just want a quiet place to refresh the soul. You are all welcome.

name: The Sundial Beach Cabana
description:
Welcome to The Sundial Beach Cabana, a private beach house located in Sittee Point. The Sundial Beach Cabana sits directly on the Caribbean sea between the sleepy little fishing village of Hopkins and the Sittee River. It is near all amenities such as restaurants, grocery stores, pharmacy, scuba diving shops and local outfitters. All are easily accessible by bicycle if you choose to not rent a car.
The house faces to the east allowing for amazing sunrises.
neighborhood_overview:
The Sundial Beach Cabana is in a quiet residential neighborhood, about 3 kilometers from the south end of Hopkins village.
Sitting half way down the coast line, many of the major tourist attractions are just a day trip away. A 40 minute boat ride will take you out to the largest barrier reef in the western hemisphere and over 400 pristine Cayes. The scuba diving and snorkeling are exceptional with Belize’s abundance of sea life along with some of the top dive sites in the world. On the mainland explore Mayan ruins, hike in the jungle and take a refreshing dip in the jungle’s infamous Blue Hole off the Hummingbird highway. Tube through caves, catch a zipline, or learn drumming from a local Garifuna drummer.
host_about:
Hi, 
We are Caroline & Jesse. We first visited Belize back in 2005 and fell in love with this small yet diverse country. In 2018, we took the plunge and bought the Sundial Beach Cabana, our home away from home. We try and spend as much time as possible there, but when we can't, we hope to share our love for Belize with others. We hope we get to host you.

My husband, Pike, is from Orange Walk, a district in northern Belize. He moved to Caye Caulker for work in 1994, which is when we met and fell in love, and we got married in 2006 on Caye Caulker.
In 2007 our daughter, Lily, was born and our daughter, Ayla, was born in 2016.
I am a scuba instructor, Pike is a retired water taxi captain and we run our rental business together. 
We love to travel and enjoy having travellers stay with us. Our business is small and intimate, allowing us to ensure that your stay in Belize is authentic, creating memories for a lifetime.
Looking forward to meeting you!

We moved to Belize in 2017 from New Jersey to enjoy year-round sun, sea, and warm weather. After years of research and reconnaissance, working multiple jobs and saving as much as possible, we finally dropped our old life, quit those jobs, and moved to Belize.  We chose Placencia as our paradise, and bought this guesthouse within weeks of arriving.  Since then we have enjoyed adapting to the “Barefoot Perfect” lifestyle of the village. We love living in this warm community full of friendly faces and being within walking distance of everywhere we need to go.

Phil’s passion is health and fitness and appreciates being active outdoors year-round. While enjoying all the perks that Belize offers, he has not totally abandoned his prior career path and still works remotely as a physical therapist. 

Megan dabbles in real estate, indulges her creative side by writing a blog (Real Life Recess) and crafting, and is also a superb source of information on expat life, village happenings,  and unique experiences.

We live onsite on the top floor of the guesthouse. We are always available to answer questions, assist with recommendations, and ensure your stay is as relaxing and memorable as possible . Please feel free to approach us at any time!

name: The Teakettle Villa With A View
description:
Right on the Western Highway, perched atop a hill overlooking the small village of Teakettle, the Teakettle Villa allows you to enjoy a 360-degree, majestic view of the Mayan mountain range and the surrounding rain forest from its rooftop deck. This brand new, modern home, allows you to experience the sounds of Howler monkeys and hundreds of species of tropical birds.

The Teakettle Villa is only 6 mi (or 10 km) South-West of Belmopan, Belize’s Capital City where the U.S. Embassy is located.
neighborhood_overview: The Teakettle Villa is your home-away-from-home in Belize. It is within walking distance to the center of Teakettle Village. You can spend your days at nearby Mayan archaeological sites, the Mountain Pine Ridge Forest Reserve where there are water falls, trails and hiking.  Within hiking distance is the TKO Farms, a 912-acre exotic hardwood and citrus tree farm made up of towering Teak, Mahogany, Spanish cedar and Zircote trees. The Teakettle Villa is only 7 miles from Actun Tunichil Mukal (ATM), the most popular Mayan burial site in Western Belize. Directly east on the Western Highway is the Belize Zoo. There is canoeing and kayaking on the Belize River, only half a mile away.  Spend your evenings relaxing on the rooftop deck watching the sun set over the Mayan Mountain range, and wake-up to the sounds of the howling monkeys.

name: Spoonbill House nr.2
description:
Live like a local in this funky house. Located off the beaten track, away from the touristy part of the island, in a mostly local residential (sometimes poor) area.

IMPORTANT: Before booking, please read the full description. Especially the part about the location ( "where you'll be") and the reviews. In your reservation request please mention that you have read the full description and understand that the house is not in the touristy part of the island.
neighborhood_overview:
This house is located outside the main village in a residential area where you live among the local people. The area does not have a touristy vibe and especially during rainy weather, the streets can be bad. Beware that Belize is a developing country and minimum wage is low. This means that few people can afford a house of their own and often more than 1 family live on a property under sometimes poor conditions.

Caye Caulker is a small island and the main restaurants, shops, supermarkets, dive-/snorkel tour operators are about a 20-30 minute walk or a 15-20 minute bike ride away. In the area close to the house are a few small food stalls and the nearest grocery store is a few minutes by bike. On rainy days (yes, we have them, it's the tropics after all) the roads can be a challenge with slippery potholes and big puddles, but if you like a bit of adventure it will be no problem at all.
host_about: Originally from the Netherlands and now living on the small tropical island of Caye Caulker in Belize. I enjoy the 'go slow' mentality of island life and live by the day.  I'm a real dog lover and work as a volunteer at the Caye Caulker Humane Society.

neighborhood_overview:
The island of Ambergris Caye, “La Isla Bonita”, is a popular tourist destination. You can get here from the mainland either via an 15 minute flight or a 90 minute boat trip.

San Pedro is a quaint little town of about 18,000 residents that has retained its charm while handling the growing number of visitors. La Perla Azul is located 4.5 miles/7+ km south of the town core, which means you are away from the crowds yet still within reach of everything. Not only will you be able to enjoy a restful day on a quiet beach, you will have a quiet night as well – no bar or restaurant noise, just swaying coconut fronds and the occasional fish jumping in the water! [Note that when coming from/to town, the road is hard packed sand for about 2.5 miles.]

Town is not far away when you want to go in for some live music, shopping, restaurants, etc. But there are things relatively close by too, such as:

Belize is the only English-speaking Latin American country, offering all the rich history, tastes and colors

Tom, Hadas & Alma

name: Casita Teresita - Romantic - Beachfront Studio
description:
Welcome!

Romantic Casita with a stunning view of the Great Barrier Reef and the Caribbean Sea. The casita is tucked among coconut palm trees on the sandy beach of Ambergris Caye. It was once a coconut grove and is a 30 mins ride on golf cart from town. The famous Secret Beach is our backyard (15 mins by golf cart).

We are Gold Standard - The Belize Tourism Board.

You may find seaweed on the beach shoreline from seasonal shifting currents and weather patterns in the region.
neighborhood_overview: Our neighbourhood is known as Mata Grande. It's one of the most beautiful areas on the island where you will find a number of private homes and a couple small hotels/condos. Casita Teresita is on the same property of Las Amapolas. It is on a lovely beach and is calm and peaceful. Since it is on a family estate sometimes you will find family members enjoying the beach. Our closest neighbour is Captain Robby that lives with his family in the compound. The main road is easily accessible but can be bumpy at times due to pot holes. Troical Escape Grill & Bar is just a three minutes walk on the beach south of the property. They are open for breakfast, lunch and dinner and allow their patrons to swim in the pool. A few steps north is Mambo's Restaurants at Mata Chica Resorts (high end/expensive). This resort offers a day pass for a fee that enables you to use their pool. These are the closest restaurants to us. There are a few others within a ten to fifteen minutes drive or many other options

name: Stay on a Maya Site, 100 Acres Jungle, by ATM Cave
description:
Sleep next to the jungle & newly excavated Lower Dover Maya ruins.

Ideal for eco-travelers looking to experience nature. This safe, clean private cabana sleeps 1-2 persons, has mosquito nets, fans, ensuite bathroom, private outdoor rain water shower & veranda with a view.

Free On-site Activities
*Hike on miles of jungle trails
*Swim in freshwater creeks
*Stargaze - free of light pollution & urban noise

Stay in the jungle, not in the city, & experience jungle life at Lower Dover.
neighborhood_overview: Our village is small (pop. 1000) but lively (6 bars & 6 churches).  But Lower Dover is on the fringe of town & secluded & quiet.   The neighbors you'll see will all be wild animals & birds since we are surrounded by jungle.
host_about: NEAR... YET TOTALLY FAR OUT! Ranked #1 Specialty lodge in western Belize by TripAdvisor!  Lower Dover is close to the famous ATM Cave & a 15 min walk from a busy public bus stop in Unitedville yet you'll feel like you are on a secluded jungle isle surrounded by rivers.  You'll be sleeping atop Maya ceremonial grounds & surrounded by 100 acres of Maya ruins, exotic wildlife, nesting toucans, deep jungle & huge trees. Come explore nature trails, swim in fresh water streams, see nesting Toucans & learn about medicinal plants & Maya/British/Mennonites history.  Awake to sounds of the rainforest & an organic farm. There are clean, safe accommodations for every budget plus adventure tours, local food, warm hospitality & big on-site Maya ruins (est. population 10,000 in 900 A.D) hidden in the jungle just outside your cabana door. Centrally located in Cayo District location (between Belmopan & San Ignacio or a 2 hour ride from Hopkins) Lower Dover is a base camp for those traveling from the BZE international airport, the coast, cayes, or Tikal. If you are from Wisconsin, get your photo taken with Bucky Badger!  blog:  LDFieldJournal.wordpress.

name: Stay on a Maya Site, 100 Acres Jungle, by ATM Cave
description:
Sleep next to the jungle & newly excavated Lower Dover Maya ruins.
Ideal for eco-travelers looking to experience nature. This safe, clean private cabana (the 'RED cabaña') sleeps 2-3 persons (1 double + 1 single), has mosquito nets, fans, A/C, private outdoor bathroom, outdoor rain water shower & veranda with a jungle view.

other rooms: COCO/Inside bathroom (fans only-no A/C), AQUA/Inside bathroom + A/C Patio + Hammocks
neighborhood_overview: Our village is small (pop. 1000) but lively (6 bars & 6 churches).  But Lower Dover is on the fringe of town & secluded & quiet.   The neighbors you'll see will all be wild animals & birds since we are surrounded by jungle.
host_about: NEAR... YET TOTALLY FAR OUT! Ranked #1 Specialty lodge in western Belize by TripAdvisor!  Lower Dover is close to the famous ATM Cave & a 15 min walk from a busy public bus stop in Unitedville yet you'll feel like you are on a secluded jungle isle surrounded by rivers.  You'll be sleeping atop Maya ceremonial grounds & surrounded by 100 acres of Maya ruins, exotic wildlife, nesting toucans, deep jungle & huge trees. Come explore nature trails, swim in fresh water streams, see nesting Toucans & learn about medicinal plants & Maya/British/Mennonites history.  Awake to sounds of the rainforest & an organic farm. There are clean, safe accommodations for every budget plus adventure tours, local food, warm hospitality & big on-site Maya ruins (est. population 10,000 in 900 A.D) hidden in the jungle just outside your cabana door. Centrally located in Cayo District location (between Belmopan & San Ignacio or a 2 hour ride from Hopkins) Lower Dover is a base camp for those traveling from the BZE international airport, the coast, cayes, or Tikal. If you are from Wisconsin, get your photo taken with Bucky Badger!  blog:  LDFieldJournal.wordpress.

description: You’ll love having easy access to town in this home with private pool & roof deck! Located close to the beach just on the southern edge of town, this home has two completely independent living spaces on each of its two levels. Up to eight total guests can be accommodated: five guests on the upper level (two bedrooms each with queen bed, plus a futon in the living area) & three on the lower level (a studio with 3/4 wall for the queen bed sleeping area plus a twin sofa bed in the living area).
neighborhood_overview:
The island of Ambergris Caye, “La Isla Bonita”, is a popular tourist destination. You can get to San Pedro (the only town on the island) from the mainland via a 15 minute flight or a 90 minute boat trip.

Casa Coccoloba is just on the southern edge of San Pedro town, so you are within easy reach of lots! The Caribbean sea is only about 350 yards away, a 5 minute walk. There are a variety of restaurants & stores within walking distance and San Pedro's Central Park, considered 'town core' (& where the water taxi docks to the mainland are located), is a mile north of the house. The San Pedro airport is less than a mile north.

With the house being on the one main north/south road, you will hear golf cart traffic as they buzz along, but generally from inside the house with the windows closed, it's not disturbing. (Note the lower level bedroom would be the one most affected by street/traffic noise.)

description: When you arrive at Villa Tortuga you will be surrounded by nature and a peacefulness that comes with your stay on the north part of the island. Your view of the Most Beautiful Turquois Water on the island right out front.
neighborhood_overview: Villa Tortuga is located 7 miles north of the hustle and bustle of town. It is located at the secluded and quite part of the island, but about a 30 minute golf cart ride away to town if you need to get crazy. People come to this part of the island to enjoy the tranquility and peacefulness. There is a resort right next door with a restaurant and bar over the water. They also have a nice swimming beach you can use. Other swimming beaches are on the lagoon side at Secret Beach about 25 minute golf cart ride away.
host_about:
I am a avid scuba diver, sailor, fisherman and love to travel to tropical places. I have been coming to Belize for over 25 years. I never dreamed that I would end up building a house here, but it happened. Villa Tortuga is finally ready after a long 4 years of hard work. Now it's time for the easy part. For you to enjoy it! 

My goal is to make your adventure/vacation as easy and stress less as possible. I want everyone to leave Villa Tortuga with amazing memories to last a life time. You are fortunate enough to have my friend Patojo who is a local that was born on the island and his wife Sabrina will be your on site host. Patojo is a local, dive guide and trained most of the guides on the island. He and his dad & brothers are the ones who set up the buoys at all the dive sites to tie your boat off to so the reef didn't get damaged with anchors back in the day before being environmental was cool. They also found and named all the dive sites you see on the maps. I will be off site but available anytime if needed.

neighborhood_overview:
Placencia is a quaint beach resort village on the Caribbean coast of Belize. Renowned for its palm-lined beaches and rich culture, this area is home to Seabird, a new development of 29 homes peacefully set along Placencia Bay.

The community offers a safe, serene, and private environment with gated security. Villa Okeanos rests on the Placencia Bay facing the glorious Cockscomb mountains.

The Seabird neighborhood is conveniently located just half a mile from the local airport and only 2–3 miles from the village, making it easy to explore Placencia.

name: Dormitory on huge jungle property with Maya site
description:
Spacious, clean and stylish 8-bed dormitory for our budget travellers. Lockers, changing room, outlets, big community desk. Located on 100 acres of beautiful jungle ('Lower Dover') with two creeks and Belize River + huge Maya site on the property. Community kitchen, outdoor bar, pool billard hall, spacious dining hall with reading lounge, board games.

We organise every tour in our area:

ATM cave (must see!)
Tikal
Caracol
Cave Tubing
Cave canoeing
Zip-lining
Horseback-riding...
host_about: NEAR... YET TOTALLY FAR OUT! Ranked #1 Specialty lodge in western Belize by TripAdvisor!  Lower Dover is close to the famous ATM Cave & a 15 min walk from a busy public bus stop in Unitedville yet you'll feel like you are on a secluded jungle isle surrounded by rivers.  You'll be sleeping atop Maya ceremonial grounds & surrounded by 100 acres of Maya ruins, exotic wildlife, nesting toucans, deep jungle & huge trees. Come explore nature trails, swim in fresh water streams, see nesting Toucans & learn about medicinal plants & Maya/British/Mennonites history.  Awake to sounds of the rainforest & an organic farm. There are clean, safe accommodations for every budget plus adventure tours, local food, warm hospitality & big on-site Maya ruins (est. population 10,000 in 900 A.D) hidden in the jungle just outside your cabana door. Centrally located in Cayo District location (between Belmopan & San Ignacio or a 2 hour ride from Hopkins) Lower Dover is a base camp for those traveling from the BZE international airport, the coast, cayes, or Tikal. If you are from Wisconsin, get your photo taken with Bucky Badger!  blog:  LDFieldJournal.wordpress.
